_comment: Detection regression suite -- docs/wazuh-tuning/plan.md Phase 0. Each case is a logtest input and the rule(s) that must fire. 'ids' = acceptable rule ids, 'min_level' = floor. Calibrated against the live ruleset before any suppression; tuning may make Wazuh quieter, never blinder. Cases with a 'sample' value need a real event captured with 'sample <rule>' (docker events), filled in at calibration.

cases.name: sshd failed login
cases.event: Oct 15 10:00:00 testhost sshd[1234]: Failed password for root from 203.0.113.5 port 4242 ssh2

cases.name: sshd successful login
cases.event: Oct 15 10:00:00 testhost sshd[1234]: Accepted publickey for root from 203.0.113.5 port 4242 ssh2: ED25519 SHA256:abc

cases.name: sshd non-existent user

cases.name: docker exec of a non-health-check command

ruleset_present._comment: Events logtest cannot produce (generated by remoted/syscheck/vulnerability-detector). Checked by asking the manager for the rules: they must exist, be enabled and meet the level floor.
